description: A line of women in dark padded coats and knit hats walks along a muddy path beside a tall chain-link fence topped with barbed wire. The lead woman carries a large patched flag with a peace symbol and a women's symbol. A small child in a knit hat holds the hand of a woman pushing a pram. Scarves are tied to the fence. Behind the fence are a flat field, a distant watchtower and grey buildings under an overcast sky. No visible text, frame or border.
